component.name: NotTeams
component.summary: Unofficial native client for Microsoft Teams chats and calls

description.p: NotTeams is a small native desktop client for Microsoft Teams. It talks to the same Microsoft services as the Teams web app, so your chats, channels and meetings are the ones you see there. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Microsoft.

ul.li: Chats and channels with pictures, files, reactions, replies and message search
One-to-one calls and Teams meetings with camera, screen sharing and background blur
Your presence and status, a calendar of your meetings and RSVP
Desktop notifications, a tray icon and a choice of sounds
